context: Yumiko and Mrs. Mori discuss international news at tea.
purpose: Two older women parsing world events.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 外国の事件、報道、毎日来ますね。
lines.en: You see reports about incidents happening abroad every single day now, don't you.
lines.style: Measured, reflective opening. Soft voice carrying the weight of observation without alarm. Slight pause before the final phrase, inviting agreement gently.

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.jp: 平和な世界、なんて、難しい時代。
lines.en: A peaceful world… these days, it's hard to imagine, isn't it.
lines.style: Wistful exhale on the opening. Warm but tinged with resignation. Slow, deliberate pace. The cadence of someone who has watched a long time and still cares.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: けれど、希望、捨てたくない。
lines.en: But I don't want to give up on hope.
lines.style: Quiet conviction underneath. Not defiant—more like a small, steady flame. Soft voice but firm line of thought. Gentle determination on the final word.

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.jp: 私たちの世代、ようけ見てきた。
lines.en: People our age have seen so much over the years.
lines.style: Warm, knowing tone—not heavy, just grounded in lived experience. Calm pace. A statement of fact that also carries quiet dignity.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 若い人にも、伝えたいわね。
lines.en: I do want to pass that on to the younger generation, though.
lines.style: Soft, earnest opening. A gentle kind of urgency underneath—not pushing, but sincere. Slight lift at the end, like opening a door.

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.jp: うん、孫たちの未来、祈るしかない。
lines.en: Yes… all we can really do is pray for our grandchildren's future.
lines.style: Warm agreement on the opening. Soft, accepting tone. The word 'pray' carries gentleness without weakness—a kind of strength that comes from acceptance.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: こうやって、話せるの、嬉しい。
lines.en: I'm really glad we can talk like this.
lines.style: Tender, grateful opening. Quiet warmth. The voice of someone who values this moment and wants it known gently, without excess. Soft close.
